agentError.signIn: Sign in to use the Agent. The quick guide is available without signing in.
agentError.accountChanged: Your account state changed. Refresh and start a new conversation.
agentError.quoteExpired: This quote expired or changed. Send the question again to get a current quote.
agentError.balance: Insufficient points. Review your balance before topping up.
agentError.rateLimit: Too many active requests. Try later; no automatic retry was made.
agentError.limit: This turn reached its processing limit. No further call was made. Check the bill for actual usage.
agentError.alreadyStarted: This request was already submitted and was not sent again. Update its usage record first.
agentError.pending: The result or cost is still being checked. Success or a refund is not confirmed. Update the usage record.
agentError.interrupted: The connection broke. The request was not automatically resent. Check usage before starting another turn.
agentError.incomplete: The reply was incomplete. No further call was made. Check the bill for actual usage.
agentError.unavailable: No reply was obtained. There was no automatic retry; check usage if a request was submitted.
